disclosure: The original '17% of businesses respond within an hour' statistic was unverifiable as stated and was replaced with the 5-minute response benchmark, a widely recognized best-practice standard rather than a measured company statistic. The four-bucket framework is an original analogy applying receivables-aging logic to lead follow-up. The Lead Response Audit description reflects the tool's actual function.

claims.text: Responding to a new lead within 5 minutes is the benchmark that separates businesses that book the job from those that lose it to a faster competitor.
The four-bucket lead aging framework applies standard receivables-aging logic to lead follow-up timing.
The free Lead Response Audit calculates a response score, estimated leads lost, and revenue at risk from four inputs.
Most missed-call text-back setups stop at a single automated reply with no assigned owner or deadline
Assigning a named person and deadline, plus keeping the interaction on one record, closes the accountability gap auto-reply alone leaves open
The Platform provides CRM pipelines, unified inbox, and booking to keep this on one record
Most CRM pipeline stages are labels with no rule for when a lead should move on
Defining one checkable exit fact per stage lets automation move leads instead of manual review
Black Arrow OS offers a free drag-and-drop pipeline with no signup
